rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=six-box: (a) iter-1 hr=0.0598 ssim=0.9243 (positive-headroom) at paper-faithful defaults proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, bf_d_w_ratio=1/6, manduca_N0=1e5, img_n_bf=1, ep=10, ~387s. (b) Limiter: under-smoothing in the projection (Q=sqrt(N0*exp(-P))) domain. With N0=1e5, Q in [0,~316] and the sqrt/Anscombe noise std ~0.5 sqrt-counts; proj_sr=1.5 only averages pixels within +/-1.5 sqrt-counts so the dominant mid-Q soft-tissue noise (where Mayo SSIM is gated) survives into the FBP. Tiny capacity (~7 params) means the range bandwidth IS the denoising strength. (c) Lever: proj_sr 1.5 -> 3.0 (one knob) widens the range kernel to ~6 noise-sigma so the proj-bilateral averages more surviving soft-tissue noise, raising calibrated-SSIM-headroom. (d) No capacity/epoch change -> same ~387s wall, well inside 20-min budget. (e) BASE_ITER=1., proj_sr=3.0
